mapped_scripts.com.apple.Notes:osa_command/make_element:
on run argv
	tell application id "com.apple.Notes"
		set theResult to «event corecrel» given «class kocl»:«class note», «class prdt»:{«class pnam»:(item 1 of argv), «class body»:(item 2 of argv)}
		return «class ID  » of theResult
	end tell
end run

mapped_scripts.com.apple.TextEdit:osa_command/document_:
on run argv
	set theFile to POSIX file (item 1 of argv)
	tell application id "com.apple.TextEdit"
		«event aevtodoc» theFile
		set theDoc to «class docu» 1
		set «class ctxt» of theDoc to (item 2 of argv)
		«event coresave» theDoc
		«event coreclos» theDoc given «class savo»:«constant ****no  »
	end tell
	return POSIX path of theFile
end run

mapped_scripts.com.apple.finder:osa_command/make_elemen:
on run argv
	set theContainer to (POSIX file (item 1 of argv)) as alias
	tell application id "com.apple.finder"
		set theResult to «event corecrel» given «class kocl»:«class cfol», «class insh»:theContainer, «class prdt»:{«class pnam»:(item 2 of argv)}
		set theAlias to theResult as alias
	end tell
	return POSIX path of theAlias
end run
